name: @untch/gov-watch
description: Untch governance watcher. A lightweight poller over the low-volume governance events on the deployed contracts — UntchReceipts' OpProposed/OpExecuted/OpCancelled/WriterAdded/WriterRemoved/AdminTransferred and SpendIntentRegistry's writer/admin events — that alerts a human through the existing escalation channels the moment one fires. It is what makes UntchReceipts' timelock + cancel() a usable defense rather than a lever nobody is watching. Not an indexer: no history, no query surface, one durable cursor.
